posts.title: WELCOME TO RESKATE
posts.description: San Van is yours. Skate it your way.
posts.body:
Welcome to ReSkate, the modding platform for skate.

Skate custom maps built by the community, drop mods into your Mods folder, and jump into servers with your crew.

Open the pause menu to find everything ReSkate adds:
- MULTIPLAYER: browse servers, host your own session, or join your friends.
- CUSTOM STUFF: world layers, parks, time of day and more.
- MODS: see what's installed and what each mod changes.

Your skater, outfits and progress are saved between sessions.

Now go find a line.

posts.title: WHAT IS RESKATE?
posts.description: A modding platform for skate, built by the community.
posts.body:
ReSkate is a modding platform for skate. It lets the community build and play custom content: new maps, models, skins and more.

WHY IT EXISTS
We love skate, and we love what the community can create. ReSkate gives modders the tools to make their own spots, parks and creations, and a place to share them, all without touching the live game.

WHAT RESKATE IS NOT
- Not a replacement for the live game. Play the official game to support it and get the full experience.
- Not a way to get live-game cosmetics for free. We do not unlock paid or store content, and we never will.
- Not a way to leak or share live-game content. Unreleased or datamined content has no place here.

OUR APPROACH
We always stay one season behind the live game. We don't want to get in the way of Full Circle or anything they have planned. New seasons, cosmetics and content belong to the live game first.

We don't support leaking content or unlocking paid cosmetics. Posts, mods or requests that do either will be removed.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
- Play custom maps made by the community.
- Use and create custom models, skins and other original content.
- Build your own mods and share them.

ReSkate is purely a way to mod skate. Make cool stuff and have fun.
